purpose: Use only immutable train objects to determine whether the V64 sub-Mpc pair mismatch is primarily caused by donor-rank dependence or by the spatial arrangement of query-local likelihood parameters, and whether a direct pair objective has a coherent shared optimization direction before any refit.

immutable_train_queries.signed_cube_isometry: identity for the value audit; the fixed train cubes are not augmented or selected by their result

source_balanced.donor_domain: cycle DOMAIN_ORDER starting at the query domain
source_balanced.donor_index: uniform immutable train object, excluding the identical query object in the identical domain

same_domain.donor_domain: identical to the query domain for every member
same_domain.donor_index: uniform immutable train object excluding the query object

spatially_permuted_rank_control.operation: an independent frozen uniform permutation of all 64^3 voxel positions per member, preserving each exact rank multiset while destroying spatial dependence

pair_probe.statistic: mean delta(x) delta(x+r) for the target and each 16-member empirical-rank control
pair_probe.per_object_error: mean over three separations of absolute ln(predicted pair mean divided by truth pair mean)
pair_probe.domain_summary: median and q90 per-object error plus each separation's median signed log ratio

gradient_coherence_probe.query_objects: the first four frozen query indices in each domain
gradient_coherence_probe.objective: source-balanced sub-Mpc pair log-ratio score using source-balanced ranks
gradient_coherence_probe.gradient_target: the shared 15-component final output-layer bias of the sealed V63 network
measurements: cosine to the leave-one-out global mean bias gradient
aggregate coefficient-0.1 pair-gradient L2 divided by bounded-NLL bias-gradient L2

selection_rules.rank_dependence_causal: same-domain ranks strictly reduce both the median and q90 per-object pair error relative to source-balanced ranks in every domain, and spatial rank permutation strictly worsens the median in every domain
selection_rules.query_parameter_spatial_arrangement_caus: rolled parameters strictly worsen the median per-object pair error in every domain
selection_rules.direct_pair_gradient_coherent: global median leave-one-out bias-gradient cosine is at least 0.5, negative cosine fraction is at most 0.25, and the coefficient-scaled aggregate pair-to-NLL bias-gradient L2 ratio is in [0.01,100]
selection_rules.select_domain_conditioned_copula: rank dependence is causal and the direct pair gradient is not coherent
selection_rules.select_direct_pair_objective: rank dependence is not causal, query-parameter arrangement is causal, and the direct pair gradient is coherent
selection_rules.select_joint_copula_and_pair_model: rank dependence, query-parameter arrangement, and direct pair gradient coherence all hold
selection_rules.no_model_selected: none of the causal branches holds or any numerical, ancestry, memory, or firewall check fails
